item.summary: Calcite engine. Huge list for IN clause canot be compiled

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
Implementor for OR operator (IN operator is translated to SEARCH/SARG and than translated to OR) generates a lot of not-null checks for the same input operand, since the input operand is nullable. But we can make a little hack - check for nulls once and convert input operand to not-nullable type. In this case OR implementor will skip not-null checks for this opeand.
POC implementation shows reduction of generated bytecode size.

For INT literals:

Count of literals Bytecode size before fix Bytecode size after fix
100 6359 793
200 13637 1565
500 36437 3965
1000 error 7965

For STRING literals:

Count of literals Bytecode size before fix Bytecode size after fix
100 5581 1627
200 12079 3217
500 32479 8017
1000 error 16017
